channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-v
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: viltrum — via awesome-v
item.description: Web framework with its own HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TLS 1.3 engine, zero allocations per request.

item.title: swelte — via awesome-v
item.description: "V in Svelte" - SvelteKit equivalent using V as backend and isomorphic code.

item.title: vsql — via awesome-v
item.description: Single-file SQL database written in pure V, following the SQL standard, with a CLI, a PostgreSQL-compatible server and an ORM.

item.title: dupfind — via awesome-v
item.description: Find duplicate files by content. Pure V, zero dependencies, with JSON output.

item.title: VCraft — via awesome-v
item.description: A voxel sandbox game written entirely in V with procedural terrain, biomes, water, mining/building, and a hotbar HUD.

item.title: webrtc-v — via awesome-v
item.description: A pure V implementation of the WebRTC protocol stack.

item.title: raknet — via awesome-v
item.description: A V implementation of the classic RakNet protocol used by Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.

item.title: create-vlang-app — via awesome-v
item.description: A V-native scaffolding CLI to generate production-ready V projects from composable templates and extensions.
